autonomous_paas.title: Autonomous PaaS Platform
autonomous_paas.description: Zero-cloud-tax autonomous deployment engine turning raw source code ZIPs into secure, containerized, HTTPS-accessible web applications in 45 seconds.

pipeline_stages.details: Accepts archive ZIPs, extracts into isolated host directories (an isolated workspace), cleans OS metadata (__MACOSX,.DS_Store), and executes recursive auto-flattening.

Inspects codebase manifests to automatically identify runtimes: Node 22 (Express/API), Next.js (Static export / Node server), Python 3.12 (FastAPI with Uvicorn, Flask with Gunicorn), and.NET 8 (C# Web API with Kestrel on port 8080).
Probes physical OS socket listeners to find guaranteed free host ports, generates multi-stage Dockerfiles and docker-compose.yml with CPU/memory limits, and executes docker compose up -d --build.
Calls NetBird REST API to register TLS route mapping to the allocated host port, streams build progress via Server-Sent Events (SSE), and protects user accounts via passwordless 6-digit email OTPs.

clickhouse_architecture.title: ClickHouse Real-Time Time-Series Data Lake

primary_tables.scale: 2,000,000+ active rows · Millions of daily telemetry events
primary_tables.key_columns: deviceid (String), timestamp (DateTime UTC), voltage_l_n (Float), current (Float), active_power (Float), power_factor (Float), frequency (Float), total_active_energy (Float)
primary_tables.partition_and_sort: PARTITION BY toDate(timestamp) ORDER BY (deviceid, timestamp)
primary_tables.query_latency: Sub-50ms analytical response times for 30-day aggregations

primary_tables.source: ESP32 DHT11 physical sensors deployed across residential and server environments

architectural_highlights: High-Availability Clustering: Engineered 2-node ClickHouse cluster with ClickHouse Keeper Raft coordination and HAProxy leastconn load balancing.
Extreme Ingestion Throughput: Benchmarked peak ingestion rate of 7.8M rows/sec (500k rows ingested in 0.064s) using ClickHouse Native Format.

Window Function Optimization: Eliminated legacy neighbor() function calls in favor of ANSI SQL window functions (any(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY deviceid ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) on ClickHouse 25+.

forensic_energy_standards.title: Mandatory Forensic Energy Calculation Standards
forensic_energy_standards.core_rule: NEVER calculate electrical energy consumption using SUM(active_power * dt) trapezoidal integration.
forensic_energy_standards.technical_justification: Trapezoidal power integration under-reports real-world consumption by 20% to 40% due to packet transmission intervals, network jitter, and dynamic load spikes. Hardware energy registers (total_active_energy) are physically metered, tamper-proof, and monotonically increasing.

five_core_forensic_kpis.forensic_role: Calculated strictly via MAX - MIN over target window to determine actual billing consumption.
Identifies voltage sags (<215V vs 235V nominal) and grid over-voltage events that stress inductive motor loads.
Monitors phase loading; triggers automated high-current alarms when threshold exceeds 15A.
Audits national grid stability (nominal 50.0 Hz); flags thermal generator trips during deviations.
Measures electrical phase displacement; diagnoses capacitor bank failures when PF dips below 0.80.

supported_protocols.use_case: Interfacing electrical smart energy meters (Eastron SDM630/120), chiller plant VFDs, and central cooling tower sensors.
Building Management System (BMS) integration, commercial office VRF indoor units, and primary AHU dampers.

supported_protocols.physical_layer: Sub-GHz RF (868 MHz Europe / 915 MHz US / 865-867 MHz India)
supported_protocols.use_case: Long-range wireless transmission from rural 11kV substation feeders and steel tower gateways to cloud receivers.
